about: Labeled pairs: `a` is a note already in a Brain, `b` a new proposal. Relations: contradicts (b cannot be true while a is), narrows (b adds an exception or condition to a), extends (b adds to a), agrees (b says what a says), unrelated. Detection is graded on contradicts.
